Get CBA Game Team Shots

Source: R/cba.R
cba_game_team_shots.Rd

Shot-zone profile of the two teams of a game. NOT game data: the teams' current season table.

Endpoint: POST https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/team-match-datas/schedule-shoot-list (JSON body)

Usage

cba_game_team_shots(schedule_id)

Arguments

schedule_id

(required) Required. CBA game id (integer), the global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx (100105799 = 2025-26 round 1). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per team (and averages); a team-season table, not game data. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cba_game_team_shots):

col_nametypedescription
bout_no_points_sortdoubleUnobserved: null in every sample (numeric value behind (Chinese text) points allowed per 100 possessions). Typed Float64 like the family's other routes.
bout_point_sortdoubleUnobserved: null in every sample (numeric value behind (Chinese text) points per 100 possessions). Typed Float64 like the family's other routes.
bout_subtract_points_sortdoubleUnobserved: null in every sample (numeric value behind (Chinese text) net points per 100 possessions). Typed Float64 like the family's other routes.
guard_field_goals_at_rimdoubleat-rim share: the share of field-goal attempts taken at the rim (inside the restricted area (Chinese text)), for the shots of the OPPONENTS against this team ((Chinese text), defence; the 'guard' prefix is inferred from the site's (Chinese text) offence/defence toggle). A FRACTION 0-1 (the API sends a percent string such as '39.4%'; the _sort column holds the same fraction).
guard_field_goals_at_rim_rankdoubleRank among the teams of that season (integer-valued number; direction per metric undocumented). Metric: at-rim share: the share of field-goal attempts taken at the rim (inside the restricted area (Chinese text)), for the shots of the OPPONENTS against this team ((Chinese text), defence; the 'guard' prefix is inferred from the site's (Chinese text) offence/defence toggle).
guard_field_goals_at_rim_sortdoubleUnformatted fraction 0-1 behind the formatted string of the metric. Metric: at-rim share: the share of field-goal attempts taken at the rim (inside the restricted area (Chinese text)), for the shots of the OPPONENTS against this team ((Chinese text), defence; the 'guard' prefix is inferred from the site's (Chinese text) offence/defence toggle).
guard_hit_at_rim_made_ratedoubleat-rim shooting percentage, for the shots of the OPPONENTS against this team ((Chinese text), defence; the 'guard' prefix is inferred from the site's (Chinese text) offence/defence toggle). seasonintegerSeason START year (2025 = the 2025-26 season). The sdv season key is the END year = season + 1; map at the boundary.
team_idintegerteamId (key space: CBA clubs; 5 digits 29115-29140 for the long-standing clubs, 9 digits for newer ones (100074683 = Ningbo); stable across seasons and club renames, but the display name changes with the sponsor: 29128 = 'Zhejiang Guangsha' under many sponsor names, (Chinese text) in 2025-26). Joins getTeam / teamList and the team and player routes. Not a player or schedule id.
team_namecharacterTeam name (Chinese) in that season; changes with the sponsor.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cba_seasons().
